title: Decoy Font
summary: Decoy Font is an experimental typography project from Mixfont that creates fonts with deceptive visual characteristics, where characters appear to be one thing but display differently depending on context - likely involving Unicode homoglyphs or visual deception techniques.
problem_solved: Demonstrates the security and design implications of fonts that visually mislead or appear different than their actual character values
why_valuable: Highlights important security concerns around Unicode homoglyphs and visual deception in typography, useful for designers, developers, and security researchers
